This single revenue example cannot establish or refute how many AI startups jointly meet the business-model, funding, and revenue conditions [e1].
limitations: The packet lacks a representative startup population and linked business-model, cumulative funding, and revenue records.

The evidence establishes only the revenue component of the Lovable example.

our_interpretation: 'Pretty much every' means an overwhelming proportion, allowing exceptions; one outlier cannot refute it.

criteria.contradiction_condition: A representative dataset shows that a substantial share of AI startups fails one or more of those conditions.
